seeds.teamWeekSeed: int(sha256(f'{seed}:{week}:{rosterId}')[:12], 16), shared by V2, V1 and F
seeds.pitUniforms: random.Random(seed) one per evaluated row in row order, shared by all models

teamWeek.pool: oracle availability: rostered players who appeared that week

SC-G1.rule: V2 PIT coverage80 (PIT in [0.1, 0.9]) in [0.75, 0.85] and PIT coverage95 (PIT in [0.025, 0.975]) in [0.9, 1.0], every gated family

nonGatingLiteralV1.rule: v1's censored central-interval coverage, reported for comparability only

SC-G2.rule: pooled mean dLS (V2-F) > 0, CI lower > 0; no gated family CI upper < 0

SC-G3.rule: pooled mean dCRPS (F - V2) > 0, CI lower > 0; no gated family CI upper < 0

SC-G4.rule: V2 ks D <= 0.08 every gated family; pooled D below F's

SC-G5.rule: V2 coverage80 in [0.65, 0.95], coverage95 >= 0.85, meanCrps <= F's
